name: Turntable Spin
description: One slow full rotation on a matte turntable with a fixed camera, so the clip can loop. Starts from a packshot you already have.
prompt: {{product}} on a matte turntable rotates one full slow turn, fixed camera, studio softbox light, subtle reflections, seamless loop feel, no text
negative_prompt: camera movement, cuts, text, warped label, flicker

slots.label: Product still
slots.help: An Element image or a packshot; it becomes the first frame.
